Author: FabioEstevam
Message:
Block 4 (Sprints 12-14): CI/CD, deployment IaC, and documentation

CI/CD: multi-stage non-root Dockerfile, 4 GitHub Actions workflows
(ci/security/docker/release), pip-audit/semgrep/gitleaks run for real
locally before being encoded. Two real production defects found and
fixed: a PermissionError from /app staying root-owned under the
non-root user, and an orphaned hf_xet subprocess going zombie with no
init process to reap it (fixed with init: true / tini) -- the latter
escalated to a stuck WSL2 VM requiring a full Windows restart to
recover, documented in full in PROGRESS.md and troubleshooting.md.

Deployment: AWS Terraform scaffolding (networking/database/application
modules, staging/production environments) -- written and structurally
real, never applied (no cloud account). Real smoke_test.sh, verified
end-to-end against the live stack. Real (if partial) graceful-shutdown
finding: application-level SIGTERM handling confirmed clean via logs;
daemon-level exit-event delivery affected by the same host instability
above. Local SBOM generation via Syft documented as a real, stated gap
after three attempts on this machine -- CI runs it correctly instead.

Documentation: architecture, API, security, evaluation, operations, and
source-registry docs written from the real codebase and real evidence,
not paraphrased from the original roadmap. ADR-012/013/014 record the
real decisions and defects behind this sprint's work.

Message:
Blocks 1-3: Foundation, RAG core, and security/evaluation/observability

Real, tested implementation of the Corporate Knowledge Assistant, built
incrementally against the technical specification in
../Corporate_Knowledge_Assistant_COMPLETO.md (a 15-sprint roadmap), with
evidence captured throughout in docs/release-gate/PROGRESS.md rather than
marked done conceptually.

Block 1 (Sprints 01-04) - Foundation: FastAPI skeleton, Docker+PostgreSQL/
pgvector, structured observability (structlog + request correlation), a
governed Source Registry with document ingestion (SHA-256 integrity,
Alembic-managed schema).

Block 2 (Sprints 05-08) - RAG core: chunking + real embeddings
(sentence-transformers), hybrid retrieval (pgvector + PostgreSQL full-text
search, RRF-fused) with cross-encoder reranking, and a grounded RAG
orchestrator (POST /ask) with citation validation, rule-based confidence,
and abstention. LLM: Anthropic Claude behind an abstract LLMProvider.

Block 3 (Sprints 09-11) - Security, evaluation, observability: JWT auth +
Argon2id password hashing, RBAC + real per-role document ACL (the roadmap's
flagship EMPLOYEE-vs-MANAGEMENT authorization test is real and passing),
per-user rate limiting, a RAG evaluation framework with a real Golden
Dataset (scripts/evaluate.py), and real distributed tracing
(OpenTelemetry -> Jaeger) + metrics (Prometheus -> Grafana).

231 tests passing (unit/integration/security/observability), 95% coverage.
Squashed into a single commit since incremental snapshots weren't preserved
across these three blocks — see docs/release-gate/PROGRESS.md for the real,
block-by-block evidence trail (including 5 real defects found and fixed
along the way).
